Name: Festival of the Mundane Redux (with Dinosaur Shirts and Boots)
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
Now with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46855]Muttering Farmer Support[/url]!

Taken from the description for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4630]Original Mod[/url]﻿.

[color=#ff00ff]"[/color]The Festival of the Mundane changes the Sewer map on the day of Spirit's Eve to a celebration full of Shadow people. There are many costumed Shadows to interact with, a small minigame with prizes, a swimming area, and special hats to purchase. Some of the hats have a side effect which can be quite useful outside of the festival.[color=#ff00ff]"[/color]

This is a revival of the original mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MouseyPounds]MouseyPounds[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MrPodunkian?gameId=1303]MrPodunkian[/url] updated to 1.6 with a few tweaks made by the Redux. It now includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4996]Dinosaur Shirts and Boots[/url] as well. The music that plays during the festival has been changed from the original and the mod now loads the Trench Coat Krobus. We also made some lighting changes.

[color=#00ff00][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors[/url] [/color] [color=#00ff00]Fully compatible.[/color] Adds portraits for the Hat Shop.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19405]More Lively Sewer Overhaul[/url]  [color=#00ff00]Fully compatible.[/color] We kept the same UID so their patches work.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark - NPC Sen (East Scarp)[/url]  [color=#00ff00]Fully compatible.[/color] We kept the same UID so their patches work.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28973]Your Friendly Neighborhood Monster Collective (Monster NPCs)[/url] [color=#00ff00]Fully compatible.[/color] We kept the same UID so their patches work.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18195]Sewer Slimes[/url] [color=#00ff00]Fully compatible.[/color] We make the slimes unable to damage you on festival day. This only applies to slimes in the sewer.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38955]The Ruffian[/url]  [color=#00ff00]Fully compatible. [/color]We move an NPC to avoid a collision. 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24397]Better Things[/url] [color=#00ff00]Fully Compatible.[/color] We patch the Wizard and Agatha into our Festival. You will probably want to turn their Festival of the Mundane off though. You can have both Festivals active since their festival is on a different day and in an entirely different season but there are a few things to consider. Their festival map does not have compatibility with More Lively Sewer Overhaul. The Better Things version of the Festival does not include the Pin Game either. Better Things does add a couple NPCs to their version of the Festival though, which we patch in.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] Compatibility would have to be on their end. [b][color=#ff0000]Currently breaks mod.[/color][/b] The festival map will not load with this installed.

[b][color=#ffff00]Translations are HIGHLY encouraged.[/color][/b]

[b][color=#00ffff]Installation:[/color][/b]
There will be [b]TWO[/b] folders. Put each folder in your mods folder. SMAPI and mod launchers like Stardrop will read it as TWO mods. Be sure both are active.

[b][size=4]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/size][/b]
